name: Improved Disengage [Combat, Psionic]
body:
You are skilled at disengaging from enemies.

Prerequisite: Disengage class feature

Benefit: When you expend your psionic focus to activate your disengage class feature, you may move 5 feet as a free action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity and does not count as a 5-foot step. You may only use this ability when leaving a threatened square.
